description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on Mistral Small 3.1 24B, tool calling and image input. Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agents.citiviewgroup.com/v1/mistral and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $1.053 per million input and $1.665 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.0124. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (tool calling, image input, streaming supported), up to 2048 output tokens. Costs $0.0124 USDC per call (x402).
